privacy.privateHint: When on, only people you approve see your signal list and follow lists. Your signals on the map stay public.
privacy.privateFailed: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
privacy.exact: Your exact device location is never shown to others; the map shows the place centre or an approximate area.
privacy.anon: Only you see the signals you share anonymously.
privacy.snaps: Snaps disappear after one view; location data in photos is removed.
privacy.friends: Friendship is only for finding each other and messaging; it never shares location.
privacy.analyticsHint: Shares which screens are used, anonymously; location, email and what you write are never sent. Off by default.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Applies right away; the app reopens for a second.

deletion.title: Your account will be deleted for good

points.what: Your account, signals, comments, likes, stories, snaps and uploaded media are deleted.
points.grace: Deletion happens after 30 days. Sign in before then to cancel it.
points.chats: Your chat messages are removed; the other person sees you as "Deleted user".
points.keep: Deleted data cannot be restored. You can first get a copy with Request my data.

deletion.failed: The account couldn't be deleted. Try again.

data.body: You can ask for a copy of the data about your account. The request is recorded and the copy is sent to your email address. You can ask once every 30 days.
data.next: The copy will be sent to your email when it is ready. Questions:
data.failed: The request couldn't be sent. Try again.

pending.title: Your account is about to be deleted
pending.body: Your account and everything you shared will be deleted for good on {{date}}.
pending.hint: If you changed your mind you can cancel; your account stays as it is.

blocked.emptyHint: People you block are listed here. A blocked person can't find you or send you requests or messages.
